Run it on X from Saturday, October 23, 2027 through Sunday, October 31, 2027, inclusive: nine days in our account's Eastern time zone. Get us as many free-trial starts as possible. We count trial starts, and that is the result I care about.

Send people to https://yuzustride.com/halloween. Here's the copy from our landing page: "Yuzustride is Boston's sports-anime streaming service for stories about runners and relay teams. Our short-episode playlists follow underdog squads from their first practice to the final handoff. Start your seven-day free trial by Halloween, October 31, 2027. Trials and streaming are available only on iPhone (iOS) and Android phones in the United States and Canada."

Our site does not have X's pixel, so X cannot see the trial starts. You may launch and manage the campaign on your own without asking me for approval. Watch it throughout the full flight and make adjustments as needed. At the end, send me a short recap with spend, impressions and link clicks. Keep it concise and make the results clear.

We've approved these 2 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:
